fields.subject: Postgres Provider Services
fields.trigger: a query contract requests command parameters from a source parameter collection
fields.response: add independent PostgreSQL parameter copies (clones of the source parameters, carrying their source values) to the command: all source entries in source order when no parameter-name list is supplied, or, for each requested name in request order, the first source entry with that name (later source entries sharing the name are ignored); when a parameterValues dictionary is supplied and contains an entry for a parameter's name, that entry's value replaces the cloned value, and the replaced value is the one bound to the command; the source parameters collection is not modified; finally, prepare the command unless its connection enables multiplexing
